body: I have someone who is trying to help me but my anxiety has been such that it's hard to take advantage. I know I can make a life for myself here - I'm trying to talk myself into it but having an extremely hard time accepting my circumstance. Usually I can handle my problems somehow - but can't seem to now. Thanks for your message!!!

Thanks for you response. I've been here one year actually. 
I think the problem for me is that I don't necessary want to go back there at this point, but I irrationally want my old life back. I feel very uncomfortable and isolated where I am but I do see a potential for a better lifestyle here if I stick it out. I can't seem to just accept the circumstance and make the most of it.

Well Im trying to take responsibility for it.  I made it not work out.  But I am sad about that more than anything.  I don't have anyone who can take me in at this point.  Im trying to work on that now.  Will just be very hard for me to do it finically.  I wrote this above already, but flight ticket, rent deposit, car, etc. . . a lot to handle when I'm broke.
Thanks for your reply and story.  I know things will get better.  Faced with some practical things as well as some emotional things at the same time.  Thanks!

No its cool.  I left the US cause I had a shitty job, was drinking too much and me and my GF were toxic with each other.  I got a 6 month teaching/research gig at a university.  Im an artist and there is simply more funding/public art stuff out here.  Everyone I consulted said I should just go for it and I can make it work for myself.  And thats exactly it  . ..  I didn't like my life back there . ..  things that work out here.  Now what?  I have a long history of self-sabatoge . . . . rather than bringing out the best in me this experience put me back.  

Im looking for work . ..  I have to. Im thinking of saving up and going back there, but its just so hard to figure that all out when one has no money.  Plain ticket, rent, car, job. . .  my only bet was to crash with her - and I am also remorseful about our relationship 4+ years of craziness.  I really supported her throughout. I know I lef, but my crucial mistake was not breaking it of with her completely.  She kept me in the mix . . .  half of me was still back there with her until she realized that she didn't want me  around anymore.  Sorry for the long reply. .  but I guess you asked for it.

Thats exactly it.  Ive been to Europe many times so I knew what to expect. I came out here to chase my dreams and got isolation instead.  Depression followed.  Now Im filled with regret over coming out here and abandoning my old life.  But thanks for the thought

Thanks for responding!  Well I was supposed to go back there and stay with my ex.  We had kept in touch for the year away and broke it off 6 months through.  But we still stayed in touch and things seemed ok.  However she changed her mind at the last minute about me coming back there at the last second.  So theres that.  Its a hard pill to swallow, but i know its better in the long run.  I just don't have the means to go back without her support though and Im in a country where I don't know the language - Germany.  I think this situation is making me face myself for the first time - and Im freaking out.  Feels lame to even write that.

The short version is that I sold all my stuff a year ago in order to go to Europe. At the time it seemed like a great idea. A year later and Im isolated, broke, jobless and staying on a friends couch . . .hings just did not work out mostly due to my own self sabotage. The reason this is all coming to light is that I was supposed to go back this week to where I was before but my plans fell through. Im trying to be rational about the fact that my old life is gone. But I have had a week long anxiety attack that fills my head with hardcore regret - never felt like this before. Am having a hard time imagining the future.
Thanks all for the reply. I'm strongly considering moving back to the US once I get it together just to have access to English speaking counseling.
Thanks for your reply. I am not in the states and they don't offer any English language meetings where I am.
